title: Geometric numerical discretization of a quasineutral hybrid model of drift-kinetic electrons and fully kinetic ions
summary: We extend the geometric electromagnetic particle-in-cell (PIC) framework, GEMPICX, to solve the quasineutral hybrid Vlasov-Maxwell equations with drift-kinetic electrons and fully kinetic ions. A structure-preserving finite difference method that employs dual grids is used. The discrete action principle for the hybrid model is derived, using the dual nature of the grids. The dynamical system for this hybrid quasineutral model does not explicitly involve the temporal evolution term for the electric field.
